topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I found out my partner has been writing a novel about me. It's an unexpected turn, but there's something intriguing about it. It's a peek into their world, a reflection of how they see us, the life we’ve built. I think I’ll read it when they're ready to share. It feels like a gift, a vulnerable and intimate expression of our relationship. I appreciate the effort and the creativity. Maybe it will give us something new to talk about, deepen our connection in ways we haven’t explored yet.
